diagnosis: The route finalizes the KYC wizard session and submits personal verification dossiers without verifying that wizard_state.user_id == current_user.id. An attacker can prematurely finalize another customer's KYC verification session or bind it with forged metadata.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/kyc/wizards/6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8/finalize HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
corrected_code:
@router.post("/api/v1/kyc/wizards/{session_uuid}/finalize")
async def finalize_kyc_wizard(
    session_uuid: uuid.UUID,
    kyc_service: KYCVerificationService = Depends(get_kyc_service),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    stmt = select(KYCWizardSession).where(
        KYCWizardSession.id == session_uuid,
        KYCWizardSession.user_id == current_user.id
    )
    res = await db.execute(stmt)
    wizard_state = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not wizard_state:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="KYC session not found")
    if wizard_state.status != "ready_for_review":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Incomplete wizard steps")
    verification_ref = await kyc_service.submit_identity_dossier(
        doc_ids=wizard_state.uploaded_doc_ids,
        personal_info=wizard_state.personal_info
    )
    wizard_state.status = "submitted"
    wizard_state.verification_ref = verification_ref
    await db.commit()
    return {"verification_ref": verification_ref, "status": "submitted"}
